query: How will multi-region projects be allocated to regions (proportional to GDP/population/beneficiaries), and what attenuation-correction approach (SIMEX, IV correction) will we pre-register for fund and capital measurement error?

response.query: How will multi-region projects be allocated to regions (proportional to GDP/population/beneficiaries), and what attenuation-correction approach (SIMEX, IV correction) will we pre-register for fund and capital measurement error?
response.answer: Multi-region projects will be allocated based on GDP and population. We will pre-register SIMEX for fund and capital measurement error correction.
